_readme: Defines which plan tiers each AI tool supports. Tools not listed in overrides inherit default_tiers. reason is internal documentation only and must never be rendered in the UI.
domain_matching_rule: Match on hostname only. Ignore paths, query parameters, and fragments, and strip www. before comparing.

midjourney.reason: No free tier or trial. Free trial suspended indefinitely since April 2023.

flux2.reason: No free plan. Credit-based paid access only (1 credit = $0.01).

runway.reason: One-time, non-renewing allotment of 125 credits with watermark and 720p cap; behaves as a trial, not a persistent free tier.

steambox.reason: 7-day trial, then paid. No persistent free tier.

notes: Sort order for Free/Trial/Paid tools: Paid > Trial > Free.
Sort order for paid-only tools: Paid > Not Subscribed.
Pill color mapping: Paid = green, Trial = amber/yellow, Free = blue, Not Subscribed = grey.
Matching priority is saved URL domain, then aliases, then exact tool_name.
reason is internal documentation only and must not be displayed.
